get.description: This API lists all the layouts configured for a module.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Status of the layout. The allowed values are active, inactive, and all

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The starting index number from where the layouts should be fetched

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of layouts to be fetched

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Name of the module whose layouts must be fetched. Standard values: tickets, contacts, accounts, calls, events, tasks, timeEntry, products, contracts. Custom modules are also supported.

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: ID of the department in which the layouts are configured

post.description: This API creates a new layout. To build the request body, first call getStandardLayoutFormat (GET /api/v1/layouts/standardLayoutFormat with the module) to obtain the sections and fields, then set departmentId, module, layoutName, layoutDisplayName, and isDefaultLayout.

get.description: Provides the standard layout format (sections and organization fields) for the given module. Use this response as the basis for the createLayout request body: unwrap data into sections, keep each field id and isMandatory (and allowedValues for pick lists), then set departmentId, module, layoutName, layoutDisplayName, and isDefaultLayout.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Name of the module to fetch the standard layout format for. Standard values: tickets, contacts, accounts, tasks, calls, events, timeEntry, products, contracts. Custom modules are also supported.

post.description: This API creates new Layout by cloning existing layout.

parameters.name: featureFlags
parameters.description: Optional feature flags that opt into additional response properties or behaviour. Multiple flags may be supplied as a comma-separated value.
